concept.material: steamed walnut wood and blackened spring steel
concept.internal_detail: minuteness of brass escapements and steel cam followers
concept.button: a small brass peg protruding from the tail
concept.shell_mechanic: The wooden ellipsoid splits along its dorsal seam and the two halves slide apart horizontally
concept.emerging_parts: Four short jointed legs and a blunt tapered snout
concept.signature_move: its steel head pivots side to side on its neck pin with a sharp click, and one front leg lifts and sets down like a single clockwork step
concept.turkish: Avrasya porsugu (ormanlarda yasayan, guclu kazici memeli) — ribbed walnut ellipsoid, steamed walnut wood and blackened spring steel

concept.internal_detail: miniature piston rods and tiny counterweight flywheels
concept.button: an old copper toggle switch projecting from the side
concept.shell_mechanic: The heavy copper casing splits horizontally and its top plate lifts away on vertical guides
concept.emerging_parts: An articulated steel boom arm and a small riveted metal scoop bucket
concept.signature_move: its hinged steel boom arm pivots upward on its pin and dips down again like a working machine piston
concept.turkish: Buharli kepce (insaat makinasi, kazici ve yukleyici) — pahli dikdortgen blok, dovme bakir ve eskimiş demir
